messages:
ashley: FYI getting multiple customer tickets since ~08:05 UTC — hosted API returning intermittent 502/504 and timeouts. error body references control-plane deps failing (auth/session and config DB reads for routing). customers reporting retries and one billing webhook failed due to 5xx.
devon: which region and any request IDs we can paste? need to triage and ring eng-sre/eng-runtime.
ashley: sample failing call (redacted):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/chat \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \ 
  -H \"X-Request-ID: r-xyz-9876\" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: r-xyz-9876

{"error":"controlplane: auth/session store timeout while validating token","code":"control_plane_auth_timeout"}
```

ashley: Region: primarily eu-west-1 first, now reports from us-east-1. Affected are hosted API customers on managed tokens flow. Ramp started ~08:03 UTC and hit peak ~08:08.
devon: paste gateway logs for r-xyz-9876 please.
ashley: gateway logs (chronological):

```
[08:06:54] gateway: incoming POST /v1/chat X-Request-ID=r-xyz-9876 src=203.0.113.5
[08:07:01] gateway: auth-service call -> 502 (upstream error) auth_req=auth-4423
[08:07:02] gateway: routing-policy fetch -> 504 (configdb read timeout) pol_req=pol-1091
[08:07:03] gateway: response 504 to client (control_plane_dependency_timeout) X-Request-ID=r-xyz-9876
```

james: I'm seeing a surge in short-lived session creations hitting the auth/session store; connection pool is saturated and auth latencies are climbing. Also configdb read p95 spiking due to a join introduced by the new policy-tagging enrichment job.
marta: billing ops here — one customer reported webhook retry exhaustion and charge duplication risk. please include billing in comms.
elena: quick ask: have we rolled anything to routing-policy or configdb in the last 24h?
james: yes, a tagging enrichment migration went live 02:00 UTC that added a left-join against policy_tags for every policy resolution. It didn't surface in staging because data cardinality is much lower there. Looks like production cardinality caused full table scans.
devon: immediate mitigation suggestions? prioritise acting on hosted customers.
james: short mitigation plan executed at 08:12 UTC:
- flip gateway routing resolution to local-policy-cache (best-effort) for hosted gateway in affected regions (ttl 30s)
- put a short circuit on auth/session validation: allow cached session tokens to be accepted for 15s while auth store recovers
- roll back the policy-tagging enrichment join (deactivate enrichment job)
- increase auth/session and configdb read pool sizes temporarily
devon: admin commands used (internal endpoints):

```
# enable local policy cache fallback (ttl 30s)
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/feature/enable -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" -d '{"feature":"gateway_local_policy_cache","regions":["eu-west-1","us-east-1"],"ttl":30}'

# weaken token strictness for 15s
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/auth/temporary_relax -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" -d '{"allow_cached_tokens_secs":15}'
```

noc-bot: :warning: alert: control-plane-auth-store-connections near capacity in eu-west-1 (08:10 UTC). Incident ID: INC-20260315-002

james: rolled back enrichment job and bumped pools at 08:14 UTC; enabled cache fallback and token grace window at 08:12-08:15 UTC. spun up one extra configdb read replica.
ashley: customer comms sent (short note linking status page + mitigation steps) to affected hosted accounts. template: support/hosted-temporary-5xx-notice.
devon: metrics after changes (5m window post-mitigation):
- gateway 5xx rate (hosted): 9% -> 1.1%
- auth/session store p95: 2.7s -> 240ms
- configdb read p95: 3.4s -> 210ms
- connection pool utilization auth: 96% -> 38%

elena: good work. action items to close out:
- permanent fix: add index on routing_policy(policy_id) and policy_tags(tag_id), rework enrichment to incremental join, add thresholds for enrichment job, autoscale read replicas faster
- add circuit-breaker on auth calls to avoid gateway backpressure and keep token grace config documented
- billing: reconcile any duplicate charges and follow up with affected customers; add webhook retry-backoff improvements
- improve staging data to better reflect prod cardinality for tagging jobs

james: filing PR for index + safer enrichment pattern, will include perf regression tests. assigned to eng-ml/eng-platform.

marta: billing will open a ticket for potential duplicate charge checks and coordinate customer credits if needed.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-002 status: mitigated -> monitoring. runbook: https://intranet.redwood/incident/INC-20260315-002

devon: closing note: root cause = enrichment job introduced expensive join causing configdb slow queries and auth/session pool exhaustion when combined with a spike in session creation. temporary mitigations kept customer impact low; permanent fixes tracked in postmortem. will notify customers with RCA + credits if billing impact validated.

ashley: keep thread pinned for RCA draft and postmortem. support: escalate any new P1s immediately.

-- end of thread --
